help: ℹ️ How it works 1. Choose a stage — the test opens inside Telegram. 2. Pick one of 6 options in each question. Answers are saved automatically. 3. If the test closes, it continues from the same place when you reopen it. 4. When you finish, the result is sent to this chat. Stages 2 and 3 unlock when you invite friends. The certificate is awarded at the final stage. Commands: /test — start the test /natija — your results /til — change language /yordam — help The result is not an IQ number: the test is not normed.
